newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Transportation Systems sells units.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Transportation Systems sells units.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Systems Inc said it sold subsidiary Downtown Theater Ticket Agency Inc (D/B/A Advance Entertainment) and six related entertainment units to Packaging Plus Services Inc for 850,000 shares of Packaging Plus Services common stock.
A U.S. Transportation Systems spokesman estimated the price at about $850,000.
USTS said it will post a fiscal fourth quarter gain of $600,000 related to the sale.

USTS said the unit's revenues would represent less than five percent of overall 1997 revenue and would have contributed "marginally" to profits. It also said the sale will enable it to focus on expansion of its three other transportation-related operating divisions.
